title: BJP’s Dinesh Arya files Rajya Sabha  nomination; eyes regional, caste balance in Uttarakhand
description: Mr. Arya's nomination is significant as he is a Scheduled Caste leader from the Kumaon region, while all three Rajya Sabha seats in the State are currently represented by leaders from Garhwal, making his candidature a move towards regional and caste balance ahead of next year's Assembly elections.
